title: Knockout Arena
description: A high-octane physics bumper battle! Slam into opponents, trigger explosive dashes, and push rivals off the floating cyber platform to be the last survivor standing.
instructions: Control your bumper sphere on the floating cyber platform.
Ram into opponents with maximum momentum to send them flying backwards.
Activate your Dash burst to deliver devastating knockback.
Stay away from the crumbling platform edges as the arena shrinks!
controls: WASD / Arrow Keys / Touch Joystick: Move & steer
Space / Tap Dash: Power dash burst
